senses.gloss: m. (פְּלַס; cmp. b. h. פֶּלֶס) circular plate or ring used as weight and as uncoined money (v. פִּילֵס).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 47b:5">B. Mets. 47ᵇ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="A02437"><he>אסימון</he></cite>, <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:1">ib. IV, 1</cite>) <he>פ׳</he> (Ar. <he>פִּילְסָא</he>) uncoined metal.

<cite ref="Shabbat 65a:14">Sabb. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>ליעבד לה פ׳</he> let him use any circular plate for it (instead of a coin, <cite ref="O01015"><he>סלע</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>פּוּלְסִין</he>, <he>פּוּלְסֵי</he>.
Lev. R. s. 37 יהבת ליה אנתתיה עשרה פ׳ וכ׳ (not יהבי) his wife gave him ten pulsin, saying, buy something &c.—פ׳ דנורא heated disks or rings strung on a lash.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:13">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>מחיוה שתין פ׳ דנ׳</he> they (in heaven) punished him with sixty fiery lashes; <cite ref="Yoma 77a:4">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> (omitted in eds.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3; Ms. M. <he>פּוּלְסִים</he> h. form); <cite ref="Chagigah 15a:6">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 47a:13">B. Mets. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה מפיק פ׳ דנ׳</he> (Rashi <cite ref="Q00242"><he>פולסא</he></cite>) he would have brought out before thee (shown thee) fiery disks (i.e. would have threatened thee with excommunication).
